properties.description: A stated conflict on a closed vocabulary is an incompatibility and says why it matters; BOTH SIDES SILENT reports as unstated with agreed=0 and a note refusing to be read as a clean bill; ONE side silent is also unstated, so a stated `none` against silence is not agreement on `none`; free-text differences report as DIFFERS and never as incompatible; genuine agreement counts as agreed; a medium mismatch is reported because it cannot be wired at all; an unresolvable pair names WHICH SIDE is missing; comparing nothing says NOTHING WAS COMPARED rather than looking like a pass; and even a clean seam names its blind spot (crates/reflow2-core/tests/seam.rs, 9 cases).
properties.findings: THE SCHEMA FAILED THREE OF THESE FIRST, correctly: Interface.medium defaulted to REST, so two silent boundaries "agreed" on a value neither had chosen.
properties.name: A stated conflict is an incompatibility, and two silences are not agreement
